$comment: The two decision calls a Voyager episode makes, lifted out of crates/voyager and given names a row can pin. `skill` is the wording SkillStore::retrieve sends: which banked skill fits a goal, with the candidates supplied per item and `none` always an option. `verdict` is the wording the critic's noul spec sends: did the agent accomplish the goal, judged by the before/after state rather than by what was attempted.

Skill options are per-item because the candidate set is the episode's own store — a suite item carries the candidates it asks over, the way program-selection items carry the programs the host resolved.
A new wording is a new set, not an edit to this one.

skill.instructions: Which banked skill best fits this goal? Answer none when nothing fits.

verdict.instructions: Did the agent accomplish the stated goal? Answer by what the state shows, not what was attempted.
